errors.error_description: Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments in the same clocked block by using a blocking assignment to update the counter while other registers use non-blocking.
Introduced an explicitly enumerated FSM state S_UNUSED that is never entered, creating an unreachable state.
Used the three-value equality operator (===) in synthesizable next-state logic to compare data_in to a constant.
Created a deeply nested if-else structure to compute acc_operand, leading to an unnecessarily long combinational path.
